source.journal: Frontiers in Neuroscience 12: 16

quote: … hummingbirds have relatively small degree of eye movements (8–12°) compared to other small avian species (e.g., Tufted Titmouse, ~38°; Song Sparrow, ~36°; Carolina Chickadee, ~35°; American Goldfinch, ~30°; Moore et al., 2013, 2015; Baumhardt et al., 2014).
note: Cited from Moore et al. (2013, 2015) and Baumhardt et al. (2014); the paper names the bird only as Song Sparrow.

method: eye movement amplitude as cited in the Discussion
